_source: NAS d'essai : DS420+, DSM 7.4.1-90080 Update 2, Text Editor 1.2.5-0254 installé depuis le serveur de Synology puis mis à jour par l'agent (packages.update). Réponse réelle du 2026-11-26, réduite à trois paquets.

packages.changelog:
What's New

  1. Supports browsing files in RAID-based virtual disk partitions via the Active Backup for Business Portal.

Fixed Issues (General Issues)

  1. Fixed an issue where version retention might not work properly for workloads protected by an immutable protection plan when the Synology NAS is joined to an ActiveProtect Manager site.
  2. Fixed an issue where a device's status might remain stuck at "Deleting" when the backup repository was busy.
  3. Fixed an issue where the error message didn't clearly explain why a device couldn't be deleted during a full machine restore.
  4. Fixed an issue where the Overview page might display an incorrectly large file size for a backup destination.
  5. Fixed an issue where a device might temporarily appear offline and ongoing backup tasks might fail or be canceled when the backup agent stopped unexpectedly.

Fixed Issues (PC/Mac)

  1. Fixed an issue where large macOS volume backups might fail because the backup agent's memory usage kept increasing.

Fixed Issues (File Server)

  1. Fixed an issue where file server backups or restores might stop unexpectedly.

Fixed Issues (Virtual Machine)

  1. Fixed an issue where backup data from different virtual machines might be mixed in the same version chain because re-registering a virtual machine on the hypervisor might cause its internal identifier to be reused.

Limitations

  1. Shared folders with storage efficiency enabled can't be used as backup destinations.
packages.desc: Active Backup for Business is designed to provide a comprehensive while centralized data protection solution, helping you back up business PCs, VMs, physical servers, and file servers all alike.

packages.changelog:
Compatibility & Installation

  1. Hyper Backup 4.2.2 requires DSM 7.3 and above.

What's New

  1. Added support for a safeguard that prevents shared folders with ongoing backup or restore tasks from being added to or removed from a tiering task, avoiding unexpected errors.

Fixed Issues

  1. Fixed an issue where a backup task might not be deleted when Hyper Backup could not connect to its remote Synology NAS or cloud backup destination.
  2. Fixed an issue where certain log entries might be incorrectly displayed as "Error" instead of "Information".
  3. Fixed an issue where Backup Explorer might not display correctly when backing up an entire system to a remote NAS running DSM 7.4.
  4. Fixed an issue where subsequent backups might fail if the source storage space or LUN capacity was expanded after the first entire system backup.
  5. Fixed an issue where the task might become unresponsive during cancellation if firewall or routing settings prevented packets from reaching the remote Synology NAS.
  6. Fixed an issue where Hyper Backup Explorer might fail to display files for entire system backups stored on Synology C2 Storage.
packages.desc: Hyper Backup helps you protect shared folder data, packages, and LUNs on your Synology storage system, providing diverse backup destinations and multiple backup versions. Restoration is available with a straightforward version-browsing interface.
